summary: Clearmind Medicine Inc. filed a Form 6-K announcing an agreement to issue and sell convertible promissory notes to CLA Investors in the aggregate principal amount of $600,000 at 90% of par ($540,000 cash), expected to close on May 19, 2026. This is a routine financing under previously amended securities purchase agreements, not a special situation. There is no board recommendation, advisor, or structural complexity beyond standard convertible note issuance. Watch for subsequent closings under the $10M facility; no risk-arb angle exists as this is a capital-raising event, not a change-of-control or restructuring.
